jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Registered Nurse (RN) Disease Manager

**Job Overview**:  

The Registered Nurse (RN) Disease Manager is responsible for coordinating care and managing the health outcomes of patients with chronic or complex health conditions. This role involves assessing, monitoring, educating, and supporting patients in managing their diseases to improve overall health and quality of life while reducing unnecessary hospitalizations and emergency care.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* **Patient Assessment**: Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients’ physical, emotional, and psychosocial needs related to their chronic conditions.
* **Care Coordination**: Work closely with interdisciplinary teams, including physicians, case managers, social workers, and other healthcare professionals, to develop and implement individualized care plans for patients.
* **Disease Education**: Provide education to patients and their families regarding their diagnoses, treatment plans, and self\-management techniques to improve disease outcomes.
* **Case Management**: Monitor patient progress and adjust care plans as necessary. Ensure that patients are following their prescribed treatment and managing their conditions effectively.
* **Data Management and Reporting**: Track patient outcomes and document interactions accurately. Utilize health information technology to document care, track patient progress, and report to appropriate stakeholders.
* **Advocacy**: Advocate for the patient’s needs, including obtaining necessary resources or services that will improve their health outcomes.
* **Prevention and Health Promotion**: Promote preventive care, including vaccinations, screenings, and lifestyle modifications to reduce the impact of chronic conditions.
* **Collaboration with Providers**: Maintain communication with healthcare providers to ensure continuity of care, timely follow\-ups, and updates on patient status.

**Qualifications**:

* **Education**: Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (BSN) or an Associate's Degree in Nursing (ADN) with appropriate certifications.
* **Licensure**: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of employment.
* **Experience**: 3\-5 years of clinical nursing experience, preferably in disease management, case management, or a related field.
* **Certifications**: Certification in Disease Management (CDM), Case Management (CCM), or other relevant certifications preferred.
* **Skills**: Strong communication, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Proficiency with electronic health records (EHR) and other healthcare technology.

jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Join a dedicated team where your work has a meaningful impact every day. As an RN Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting physicians and interdisciplinary teams to enhance patient care, improve clinical outcomes, and optimize healthcare resources. You will be responsible for coordinating care, facilitating transitions, and ensuring patients receive high\-quality, cost\-effective treatment.


This position offers flexible scheduling, opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive work environment committed to excellence in patient care.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a designated patient caseload, ensuring effective care planning and transitions.
* Facilitate precertification and authorization processes with payors.
* Collaborate with medical teams to coordinate patient care across the continuum.
* Identify and remove barriers to timely and efficient care delivery.
* Utilize process improvement methodologies to evaluate patient care outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with federal and state regulations, including CMS Conditions of Participation, EMTALA, and The Patient Bill of Rights.
* Perform admission, continued stay, and discharge reviews to determine medical necessity and resource utilization.
* Partner with healthcare providers and leverage evidence\-based practices to enhance patient outcomes.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Associate’s Degree in Nursing (ADN) required.
* Current California RN license.
* 1\-3 years of hospital inpatient or related experience.
* Ability to effectively coordinate with provider networks, including Health Plans, IPAs, and FQHCs.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN).
* Certification in Case Management.
* Bilingual skills (Spanish preferred).
* Basic computer proficiency.
* Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Competitive pay**: $53\.07 \- $82\.27 per hour.
* **Flexible scheduling** to support work\-life balance.
* Night shift employees receive a $7\.00 per hour differential.
* **Benefits**


	+ No cost medical, dental and vision option, Generous PTO plan, 403(b) employer match, Protective Equipment, Tuition reimbursement, Employee Wellness Program, Onsite childcare, Loan Forgiveness eligible facility, etc.

### **Work Environment**

* Full\-time positions available.
* 10\-hour daytime shifts

**Patient Care Coordinator – Part\-Time**

**Location:** San Marcos, California, 92078

**Pay:** $20–$22 per hour, based on experience

**Schedule:** Approximately 4–12 hours per week

**Employment:** Part\-time, non\-exempt W‑2

**About Collaborative Health**

Sprague Medical Corp, DBA Collaborative Health, is a growing primary care practice in San Marcos. Led by Dr. Tyler Sprague, the practice provides personalized, patient\-centered care focused on helping adults achieve their optimal health and well\-being.

Our small, collaborative team values thoughtful communication, dependable service, efficient operations, and strong relationships with patients and community partners.

**Position Summary**

Collaborative Health is seeking a friendly, organized, and resourceful Patient Care Coordinator to support patient communication, front\-office operations, referral coordination, marketing, and community outreach.

The Patient Care Coordinator is often the first point of contact for patients and plays an important role in creating a welcoming, organized, and responsive experience. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys helping patients, improving how a small practice operates, and contributing creative ideas. The coordinator will have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects and potentially expand their responsibilities and hours as the practice grows.

**Patient Coordination and Front\-Desk Support**

* Welcome patients and create a professional, positive front\-desk experience
* Check patients in and confirm demographic, insurance, and medical\-group information
* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and coordinate appointments
* Manage the provider’s clinic calendar and coordinate patient follow\-up
* Answer incoming calls and assist patients professionally and compassionately
* Monitor voicemail and route messages to the appropriate person
* Monitor incoming practice emails and respond or route them appropriately
* Communicate appointment instructions and follow up on required paperwork
* Respond to general administrative questions without providing medical advice
* Escalate clinical questions and symptom\-related concerns to the physician
* Collect patient payments and provide receipts when applicable
* Coordinate with the physician to support efficient patient flow
* Maintain an organized and welcoming reception area
* Support scheduling and administrative workflows for primary care and Social Security disability examinations

**Referral and Administrative Coordination**

* Process and track referrals from submission through completion
* Follow up on referral status and help resolve missing documentation
* Coordinate with specialists, health plans, IPAs, pharmacies, and outside medical offices
* Request, receive, and organize medical records
* Scan, upload, fax, and accurately file documents
* Assist with insurance verification and medical\-group assignment
* Help patients navigate basic scheduling, referral, and insurance\-related questions
* Maintain accurate records of pending tasks and follow\-up needs
* Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA requirements

**Marketing and Communications**

* Assist with planning, creating, and scheduling social media content
* Create or update basic graphics, flyers, and patient\-education materials
* Make routine website updates, including services, provider information, announcements, and events
* Help prepare and distribute email newsletters
* Gather practice updates, community news, and content ideas
* Maintain consistent branding and messaging across digital and printed materials
* Monitor basic engagement and recommend ways to improve outreach
* Assist with patient testimonials and online reviews in accordance with practice policies

**Community Outreach and Practice Growth**

* Help build relationships with community organizations, senior communities, insurance brokers, and referral partners
* Coordinate physician talks, community presentations, and outreach events
* Prepare outreach materials and follow\-up communications
* Maintain organized contact lists for referral and community partners
* Identify appropriate local partnership and marketing opportunities
* Represent Collaborative Health professionally in community communications

**Workflow Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve patient communication and office efficiency
* Help create and update templates, checklists, scripts, and standard operating procedures
* Organize referral, scheduling, record\-request, and patient follow\-up workflows
* Recommend practical improvements based on recurring patient or staff needs
* Help implement systems that improve consistency and reduce missed follow\-ups
* Take initiative while communicating proposed changes with practice leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* At least one year of recent experience in a medical front\-office, medical receptionist, or patient\-coordination role
* Experience using an electronic health record (EHR) system, including scheduling, updating patient information, uploading records, and managing administrative workflows
* Familiarity with insurance verification, referrals, and medical\-record workflows
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Professional, compassionate, and patient\-focused
* Strong customer\-service, telephone communication, organization, and follow\-through
* Comfortable handling calls, messages, documents, and competing priorities
* Ability to work independently after initial orientation
* Sound judgment and the ability to escalate clinical or sensitive matters appropriately
* Reliable availability on Tuesdays and Thursdays

**\#140489 Brain\-FRAMe Care Coordinator \- Psychiatry**
--------------------------------------------------------


**Filing Deadline: Fri 7/31/2026**
  

**UC San Diego values and welcomes people from all backgrounds. If you are interested in being part of our team, possess the needed licensure and certifications, and feel that you have most of the qualifications and/or transferable skills for a job opening, we strongly encourage you to apply.**  

  

*UCSD Layoff from Career Appointment*: Apply by 07/22/2026 for consideration with preference for rehire. All layoff applicants should contact their Employment Advisor.


*Reassignment Applicants*: Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

**DESCRIPTION**
===============


UCSD Department of Psychiatry is one of the most innovative and productive academic departments in the country, offering challenging career opportunities in the diverse areas of advanced educational programs, cutting\-edge research, and state\-of\-the\-art clinical services. The department is committed to offering a dynamic learning environment and growing opportunities to its talented and dedicated employees.


The HIV Neurobehavioral Research Program (HNRP)\-Center for Medicinal Cannabis Research (CMCR) provides broad scientific and programmatic leadership for multi\-disciplinary research programs related to HIV or cannabis or both. As part of its leadership role, the HNRP\-CMCR stimulates and helps coordinate interdisciplinary collaborative research at the local, regional, national, and international levels, and also serves as a resource for consultation, training and career development for investigators working in HIV/AIDS, cannabis and associated issues. The HNRP\-CMCR greatly facilitates research progress by identifying and broadly encouraging work on important topics, and by offering potential investigators (a) multidisciplinary consultation and training, (b) coordinated access to data and biological specimens from existing human subjects cohorts, and (c) state\-of\-the\-art expertise with statistics, data management, and recruiting of new participant groups to meet specific needs of the proposed investigation. The HNRP\-CMCR also supports information exchange among investigators and trainees via web based resources including access to project reports, links to recent literature and conference materials, webcasts, and support for video conferencing.


Under general supervision, the Care Coordinator will independently provide support to people with HIV (PWH) with and without methamphetamine use disorder who are electing to start long\-acting injectable antiretroviral therapy (LAI\-ART) at the UCSD Owen Clinic, and they will coordinate recruitment and retention into the Brain\-FRAMe study. This position will provide coordination of care in support of the Brain\-FRAMe research study. Working within the Participant Accrual and Retention (PAR) unit of the HNRP\-CMCR, the Care Coordinator will serve as a liaison between the clinic, the patient, and the research study team. They will text and call participants (e.g., with reminders), accompany participants to study visits, connect patients to existing psychosocial support services (such as transportation to clinic visits), etc. The Care Coordinator will keep track of the nature of their interactions with participants (i.e., what they did for the patient) and the time devoted to participants (i.e., how much time did they spend in coordination activities with the participant). They will also coordinate the completion of web\-based surveys for providers/staff and patients, record attendance and assessments at workforce education events, keep notes on implementation team meetings, and participate in the collation and organization of data. These duties include: screening, enrolling, and scheduling new participants in studies; interviewing new participants and gathering research data for analysis; presenting data to case conference team; tracking enrollment milestones and evaluating barriers to enrollment; making public presentations to educate and recruit research study participants; and initiating and maintaining regular contact with members of the local community including those serving individuals with HIV, mental health disorders, and substance use. Assist with other project and miscellaneous duties as required.

==========================

* Six years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus two years of related experience/training.
* Two or more years of experience in a research setting providing outreach and education and performing screening interviews for health research studies.
* Familiarity with IRB guidelines related to human subjects research including obtaining informed consent, proper collection and documentation of study data and participant interactions.
* Familiarity with San Diego health clinics, hospices, and human service organizations that provide HIV, HCV and/or substance abuse care and service and demonstrated ability to provide referrals to these organizations.
* Ability to deal with confidential matters with tact and diplomacy
* Solid written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
